policy: Exclude any identified full proof or disproof claim for the exact statement, irrespective of acceptance. Retain full problems with only partial or special-case results.
method: Dated web searches using problem names and proof/claimed proof/settle/complete proof phrases; primary-source scope checks; previous source review in the same session.
limitation: Bounded search, not proof that no claim exists anywhere. No assessment of claimed-proof correctness is required for exclusion.
